reviews.t: Did not work for my thin nails
reviews.x: I have yet to find a nail polish or nail polish / base coat / top coat combination that actually works on my nails. Maybe it's just me, because my nails seem to be thinner and more flexible than lots of people's, but no matter what polish I wear, it always chips within a day. This base coat did not extend the life of my manicure any more than polish alone. Perhaps it's a coincidence, but my nails also took longer to recover after I removed this product. This stuff not only keeps any polish on for days, it keeps gems on WITHOUT moving for days! I painted my nails Color Club Spell It Out and out a butterfly gem on one of my nails and this picture shows 4 full days with no chipping and that butterfly stayed on strong with 4 showers, cleaning my house,  doing dishes, typing on my laptop. I promise this stuff is AMAZING and works great!!!

I had never really found a base coat I was too crazy about before this one. It dries really fast so I'm not waiting around to apply my color. I can tell a big difference in how long my polish lasts now versus before I started using it. I'll definitely buy more when the time comes.

I am not particularly hard on my nails; I use gloves when I wash dishes, so I don't know if I am doing something wrong. reviews.t: I don't see how it is better than no base coat
reviews.x: For me, the color nail polish coat adheres to this fine (why wouldn't it?), but within a few days the base coat separates from the nail. I'm not sure what the advantage is versus using no base coat at all.  Update June 2014: It might not be the product's fault. I learned that some people have naturally oily nails, just like hair and skin can be oily, and this would inhibit good adhesion. I was very excited to recieve this base coat.  I am attempting to grow my nails longer, now that I am getting older.  I would never purchase this product agaian. This base coat does not keep my polish on, and it creates not barrier for my darker polished. I put this on and then painted two top coats and my nails were still stained red from the polish.  I am very dissatisfied.

I've never really used a "base coat" before, but I heard they help! So I ordered this and received it quick! I went to go do my nails and put on one coat and it dried so fast! No waiting around long to start my colored coat of nail polish. Now lets hope it truly does help keep your polish on ;)

My nails are weak, and always breaking, or splitting.  I discovered this adhesive, and it puts a pretty good coating on your nails.  I get splits  real often, and I don't have to cut my nail down, I just get my China Glaze adhesive out.  Great Product!!!!!!!

It goes on fine but my nail polish will peel off the whole entire nail. It's like it adheres to the polish but not my nail so it just comes off all at once. I find myself using different base coats because this one just doesn't work well for me.

Makes my nail polish stick better and the drying time is fast. I do 1 coat of this, 2 coats of my polish, 1 more coat of this and then finish it off with China Glaze's Good to Go topcoat. It last for 7-9 days!

claims.text: Many reviewers say this base coat significantly extends manicure wear, with several reporting a week or more without chipping.
Some reviewers report it did not work for them, with polish chipping within a day or a few days.
A few reviewers describe only modest improvement over using no base coat, getting a few days rather than a full week.
Some reviewers note it dries fast, making application quicker.
A couple of reviewers mention it works especially well combined with a top coat.
